purpose_zh: 把自动驾驶公共带的资源类别、决策权、暂停权和最小证据放在同一张可审阅板上。它描述确认程序，不任命现实主体，不提供预算或采购承诺。
purpose_en: Place resource classes, decision rights, stop authority, and minimum evidence for the autonomous-mobility commons on one reviewable board. It describes a confirmation procedure, not real appointments, budgets, or procurement commitments.

principles.rule_zh: 人工等价服务、连续无障碍路线和申诉入口未确认时，资源只能用于观察和补证据。
principles.rule_en: Until human-equivalent service, an accessible continuous route, and an appeal route are confirmed, resources stay in observation and evidence completion.

principles.rule_zh: 企业、研究或技术提案角色可以提出候选，但不能单独确认安全、公共利益或扩展。
principles.rule_en: Enterprise, research, or technical proposers may submit a candidate but cannot alone approve safety, public interest, or expansion.

principles.rule_zh: 资金、设备、算力或数据支持不能换取永久路缘、免于复核或更高评分。
principles.rule_en: Funding, equipment, compute, or data support cannot buy permanent curb access, an exemption from review, or a higher score.

resource_classes.holds_zh: 人工入口、等价路线、现场解释和申诉回接
resource_classes.holds_en: Staffed entry, equivalent route, on-site explanation, and appeal handoff
resource_classes.resource_route_zh: 经授权的公共服务采购、维护安排或参与支持，当前未落实
resource_classes.resource_route_en: Authorized public-service procurement, maintenance arrangement, or participation support; not secured here
resource_classes.veto_zh: 无等价人工服务、路线被截断或申诉无人接手时暂停
resource_classes.veto_en: Pause when equivalent human service is absent, the route is cut, or an appeal has no handoff
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_zh: 有日期的无障碍走读、人工服务协议和申诉回执
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_en: Dated accessibility walk, staffed-service contract, and appeal receipt

resource_classes.holds_zh: 空间窗口、现场标识、清场和恢复公共通行
resource_classes.holds_en: Space window, on-site marking, clearance, and restoration of public passage
resource_classes.resource_route_zh: 经权属和消防核验的可撤设施、维护和恢复资源，当前未落实
resource_classes.resource_route_en: Reversible installation, maintenance, and restoration resources after rights and fire review; not secured here
resource_classes.veto_zh: 权属、消防净空或恢复条件不清时不得固定化
resource_classes.veto_en: Do not make it permanent when rights, fire clearance, or restoration conditions are unclear
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_zh: 空间授权、状态牌、清场演练和恢复照片或记录
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_en: Space authorization, status sign, clearance drill, and restoration record

resource_classes.holds_zh: 测试资格、风险复核、事件记录和是否进入下一门
resource_classes.holds_en: Test eligibility, risk review, incident record, and the next-gate decision
resource_classes.resource_route_zh: 经授权的专业评估、保险和应急服务合同，当前未落实
resource_classes.resource_route_en: Authorized professional evaluation, insurance, and emergency-service contracts; not secured here
resource_classes.veto_zh: 缺保险、人工接管、应急联络或独立复核时否决扩展
resource_classes.veto_en: Veto expansion when insurance, human takeover, emergency contact, or independent review is missing
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_zh: 责任接受、保险或等效要求、接管演练和独立复核意见
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_en: Accountability acceptance, insurance or equivalent requirement, takeover drill, and independent review

resource_classes.holds_zh: 目的限定、最小字段、访问记录、删除和版本差异
resource_classes.holds_en: Purpose limitation, minimum fields, access log, deletion, and version difference
resource_classes.resource_route_zh: 目的限定的授权研发或公共记录服务，当前不开放个人连续数据
resource_classes.resource_route_en: Purpose-limited authorized research or public-record service; no continuous personal data is opened here
resource_classes.veto_zh: 越权、无法删除或把合成读数包装成现场结果时冻结
resource_classes.veto_en: Freeze when access exceeds purpose, deletion is impossible, or synthetic readouts are presented as field results
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_zh: 数据用途声明、权限表、删除证明和合成/现场分界
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_en: Data-purpose statement, permission table, deletion proof, and synthetic/field boundary

resource_classes.holds_zh: 停止、撤除、修复、公开 release note 和下一次复核
resource_classes.holds_en: Stop, removal, restoration, public release note, and the next review
resource_classes.resource_route_zh: 经授权的维护与撤场安排，当前未落实
resource_classes.resource_route_en: Authorized maintenance and exit arrangement; not secured here
resource_classes.veto_zh: 没有撤场责任、修复路径或公开答复时不得启动新窗口
resource_classes.veto_en: Do not open a new window without an exit owner, restoration path, and public response
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_zh: 撤场清单、关闭记录、异议答复和下一轮资料清单
resource_classes.minimum_evidence_en: Exit checklist, closure record, objection response, and next-round evidence list

decision_stages.can_propose_zh: 研究、企业、社区或公共服务问题提出角色
decision_stages.can_propose_en: Research, enterprise, community, or public-service problem proposer
decision_stages.must_hold_zh: 问题范围、临时空间锚点、人工入口和资料用途
decision_stages.must_hold_en: Problem scope, provisional anchor, human entry, and data purpose
decision_stages.decision_zh: 只登记，不启用自动化资源
decision_stages.decision_en: Register only; do not activate automated resources
decision_stages.stop_zh: 边界、权益或责任不清即留在观察阶段
decision_stages.stop_en: Remain in observation when boundary, rights, or accountability is unclear

decision_stages.can_propose_zh: 提案角色提交，独立专业和公共利益角色复核
decision_stages.can_propose_en: Proposer submits; independent professional and public-interest roles review
decision_stages.must_hold_zh: 人工服务、空间授权、安全保险、数据权限和撤场安排
decision_stages.must_hold_en: Human service, space authorization, safety insurance, data permission, and exit arrangement
decision_stages.decision_zh: 任何一项缺失都只能做纸面或合成回放
decision_stages.decision_en: Any missing item limits the work to a paper or synthetic replay
decision_stages.stop_zh: 不满足最小资源包，不进入现场窗口
decision_stages.stop_en: Do not enter a field window without the minimum resource set

decision_stages.can_propose_zh: 已确认责任角色共同申请，提案方不能单独放行
decision_stages.can_propose_en: Confirmed accountable roles apply together; the proposer cannot release alone
decision_stages.must_hold_zh: 时间窗、清场、人工接管、事件记录、公众异议和恢复
decision_stages.must_hold_en: Time window, clearance, human takeover, incident record, public objection, and restoration
decision_stages.decision_zh: 采用、暂停、修订或退回人工四种结果都要留凭证
decision_stages.decision_en: Accept, pause, revise, or return-to-human must each leave a receipt
decision_stages.stop_zh: 最慢群体受损、接管失败或异议无答复即退回 RDB-1
decision_stages.stop_en: Return to RDB-1 when the slowest group is harmed, takeover fails, or objections go unanswered

decision_stages.can_propose_zh: 独立复核与公共利益角色共同提出，维护角色确认可执行
decision_stages.can_propose_en: Independent review and public-interest roles propose together; maintenance confirms executability
decision_stages.must_hold_zh: 版本差异、负面结果、删除证明、修复状态和下一次复核日期
decision_stages.must_hold_en: Version difference, negative results, deletion proof, restoration status, and next review date
decision_stages.decision_zh: 扩展不是默认结果，缺证据时保持人工服务和公共通行
decision_stages.decision_en: Expansion is not the default; keep human service and public passage when evidence is missing
decision_stages.stop_zh: 没有可回放的责任答复和撤场记录不得发布下一版
decision_stages.stop_en: Do not release the next version without replayable accountability and exit records

boundary_zh: 本板只定义资源类别与确认程序，不填预算金额、机构名称、供应商、保险结果、许可或运营绩效。
boundary_en: This board defines resource classes and a confirmation procedure; it supplies no budget amounts, institution names, vendors, insurance results, permits, or operating performance.
recompute_trigger: official geometry, rights, safety, insurance, accessibility, authorization, or public-baseline inputs change
